name: pressure-plenum
description: Skin-and-rib under pressure: a sealed 50 x 36 x 24 mm plenum at 10 bar gauge, printed in AlSi10Mg. The cavity keeps a 2 mm wall (the skin); the optimizer adds ribs in the 6 mm outside it until the part holds a safety factor of 3. Its flat walls see the same bending stress as a 100 x 72 mm plenum's 2 mm walls at 2.5 bar of boost. No supports: a sealed cavity's pressure balances on itself.
